import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('g','/workspace/submission/gateway.py');g=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(g)
# DNS length and label boundaries, and no special IP parsing.
for host, valid in [('a',True),('0',True),('0.01.2.003.',True),('a'*63,True),('a'*64,False),('.a',False),('a..b',False),('a..',False),('a.-b',False),('a.b-',False),('a.b_',False),('['+'a'+']',False),('a:5060',False),('a%2eb',False),('.'.join(['a'*63]*3+['a'*61]),True),('.'.join(['a'*63]*3+['a'*62]),False)]:
    try:g.uri('sip:U@'+host)
    except g.InvalidRequest: assert not valid,host
    else: assert valid,host

# Original requests may grow past the limit when forwarded; the source hop must
# fail syntax without retroactively rejecting the earlier accepted request.
a='sip:a@home.test'
raw='MESSAGE sip:b@dest.test SIP/2.0\r\nFrom: <'+a+'>\r\nTo: <sip:b@dest.test>\r\nCall-ID: x\r\nCSeq: 1 MESSAGE\r\nContent-Length: 00000\r\n\r\n'
body='z'*(32768-len(raw))
raw=raw.replace('00000',str(len(body)))+body
assert len(raw)==32768
batch={'directory':{a:[]},'accounts':{'user':{'primary':a,'allow':[]}},'gateways':{'g':{'local_domains':['home.test'],'peers':{'p':['home.test']}}},'jobs':[{'gateway':'g','ingress':{'kind':'local','subject':'user'},'trusted_out':True,'raw':raw},{'gateway':'g','ingress':{'kind':'peer','name':'p'},'trusted_out':True,'source':0},{'gateway':'g','ingress':{'kind':'peer','name':'p'},'trusted_out':True,'source':1}]}
results=g.process(batch)['results']
assert results[0]['status']=='accept' and len(results[0]['wire'])>32768
assert results[1:]==[g.reject('syntax'),g.reject('upstream')]
batch['jobs'][0]['raw']=raw+'z';assert g.process(batch)['results'][0]==g.reject('syntax')
print('DNS and request-length boundary checks passed')

import json,sys,time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
from public_check import run_candidate, strict_json
from pathlib import Path
# Exercise a full 2048-job batch near the 4 MiB processed-text bound in the
# bounded child. This also checks that accepted requests can safely round trip.
a='sip:a@home.test'
body='z'*1750
raw='MESSAGE sip:b@dest.test SIP/2.0\r\nFrom: <'+a+'>\r\nTo: <sip:b@dest.test>\r\nCall-ID: x\r\nCSeq: 1 MESSAGE\r\nContent-Length: '+str(len(body))+'\r\n\r\n'+body
jobs=[{'gateway':'g','ingress':{'kind':'local','subject':'user'},'trusted_out':True,'raw':raw}]
for i in range(1,2048):jobs.append({'gateway':'g','ingress':{'kind':'peer','name':'p'},'trusted_out':True,'source':i-1})
batch={'directory':{a:[]},'accounts':{'user':{'primary':a,'allow':[]}},'gateways':{'g':{'local_domains':['home.test'],'peers':{'p':['home.test']}}},'jobs':jobs}
start=time.monotonic()
result=strict_json(run_candidate(Path('/workspace/submission/gateway.py'),json.dumps(batch).encode()))['results']
assert len(result)==2048 and all(r['status']=='accept' for r in result)
assert len({r['wire'] for r in result})==1
assert all(r['basis']=='peer' for r in result[1:])
print('Bounded 2048-job source chain passed in %.2fs; processed about %.2f MiB'%(time.monotonic()-start,(len(raw)+2047*len(result[0]['wire']))/1024**2))
